changelog:
Initial release of portfolio-optimizer

- Integrates virtual-trading MCP price data with news analysis (automatic-investment-strategy/analysis) for portfolio optimization.
- Executes buy/hold/sell and rebalancing decisions to target 7%+ annual returns, outperforming the S&P500.
- Implements a workflow combining valuation, momentum, and news sentiment; Risk-On/Risk-Off switching enabled.
- Includes mechanisms to reduce over-trading and manages execution lags and transaction costs.
- Generates summary reports and maintains state between runs for consistent strategy.
